titleStmt.title: Nursery Poems: From the Ancient and Modern Poets
titleStmt.author: John Golby Rusher

publicationStmt.p: This TEI edition was created for the TXTDS 404 course project at the University of Washington during Spring 2026. The project encodes selections from Nursery Poems: From the Ancient and Modern Poets using TEI P5 guidelines in order to preserve the literary and material characteristics of the nineteenth-century chapbook.

sourceDesc.p:
This transcription is based on the nineteenth-century chapbook Nursery Poems: From the Ancient and Modern Poets, attributed to John Golby Rusher.
Rusher, John Golby Nursery Poems: From the Ancient and Modern Poets Banbury J. G. Rusher 19th century

editorialDecl.p: This project follows a semi-diplomatic transcription approach. Original spelling, capitalization, punctuation, and formatting are preserved wherever possible. Editorial normalization and correction may later be encoded using TEI elements such as choice, orig, reg, sic, and corr.
